object.attr: derived: unbroken runs (a path or a hash), narrow attribute columns, tables wider than the page and rows taller than a page put text past the edge, where print loses it (CF-P27, CF-P40, CF-P41, CF-P42; D-P13). Takes in the former table-width requirement and the tall-row case (review Q32), which are this requirement's test cases.
object.description: The exported PDF shall show each character taken from the document within the text area or the header of a page, overlapping no other text.
